race.comment: SEQUISTA (4) frustrating filly who gets one more chance after closing strongly when second over 1300m at Rosehill in this company. Will relish the strong tempo with the senior rider taking the reins. LADY INVICTUS (9) ploughed through the heavy going to make it two wins for the prep when she shouldered the 59.5kg as fav over 1200m at Canterbury. Looks up to this and has the speed to get over from the awkward gate. Can feature again. SANCTIFIED (1) is holding his form and this looks much easier after finishing fourth over 1200m at Rosehill in BM78 grade. Each-way from the good gate. ASTRONOMIX (2) was too good on the heavy deck at Canterbury last time out and looks ready to take the next step now.
